summary: 陈桥兵变代周建宋，杯酒释兵权以强干弱枝，先南后北平定诸国的开国之君。
summary_en: The founding emperor who replaced the Zhou and founded the Song through the Chenqiao Mutiny, released his generals' military power over a cup of wine to strengthen the trunk and weaken the branches, and pacified the rival states south first and north later.

portrait.appearance_basis: 传统画像符号化描写居多。图像为依时代冠服所作的 AI 艺术想象。

timeline.title: 陈桥兵变
timeline.summary: 兵变黄袍加身，代周建宋，定都开封。陈桥是否预谋为争议层。
timeline.summary_en: The mutiny draped him in the yellow robe; he replaced the Zhou, founded the Song, and fixed the capital at Kaifeng, though whether Chenqiao was premeditated remains disputed.

timeline.title: 定都开封
timeline.summary: 宋都汴京，五代积习上的新朝。
timeline.summary_en: The Song made Bianjing its capital, a new dynasty built on the accumulated habits of the Five Dynasties.

timeline.title: 杯酒释兵权
timeline.title_en: Dismissal over a Cup of Wine
timeline.summary: 以酒宴方式解除禁军宿将兵权，强干弱枝开端；细节有演绎。
timeline.summary_en: Over a wine banquet he stripped veteran palace-army generals of their commands, opening the path of strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches; the details have been embellished in later retellings.
sources: 宋史·相关列传/长编系统
续资治通鉴长编·建隆二年

timeline.title: 平荆湖
timeline.summary: 慕容延钊等平湖南、荆南，先南后北的第一步。
timeline.summary_en: Murong Yanzhao and others pacified Hunan and Jingnan, the first step of the south-first, north-later plan.

timeline.title: 灭后蜀
timeline.summary_en: Wang Quanbin and others destroyed Later Shu.

timeline.title: 灭南汉
timeline.summary: 潘美等灭南汉，岭南入宋。
timeline.summary_en: Pan Mei and others destroyed Southern Han, and Lingnan entered the Song.

timeline.title: 灭南唐
timeline.summary_en: Cao Bin pacified Jiangnan, and Li Yu surrendered.

timeline.title: 太祖崩
timeline.summary: 崩于开封，在位结束；「烛影斧声」等为争议层，轻点不坐实。
timeline.summary_en: He died at Kaifeng and his reign ended; tales such as "the candle shadow and the axe sound" belong to the disputed layer, touched on lightly rather than asserted as fact.

timeline.title: 太宗即位
timeline.summary: 太宗立，朝廷人事与年号随之更始；金匮之盟为争议层。
timeline.summary_en: Taizong took the throne, and court personnel and the era name began anew; the Golden Coffer Pact belongs to the disputed layer.

timeline.title: 先南后北
timeline.summary: 平荆湖、后蜀、南汉、南唐等，统一南方战略。
timeline.summary_en: He pacified Jinghu, Later Shu, Southern Han, Southern Tang, and others, a strategy of unifying the south.

timeline.title: 强干弱枝
timeline.summary: 收精兵、分事权，宋代国势路径。
timeline.summary_en: He gathered in elite troops and divided administrative authority, the Song dynasty's path of state power.

timeline.title: 重文抑武
timeline.summary: 抬高文官、分化兵权，奠定宋代国势路径。
timeline.summary_en: He elevated civil officials and split military authority, laying the Song dynasty's path of state power.

relations.note_en: In Kaibao 8, destroys Southern Tang; Li Yu surrenders

bio_md:
# 宋太祖 · 主要事迹

赵匡胤本是后周禁军将领，为[[zhou-shi|后周世宗]]旧部。建隆元年（960），陈桥驿兵变黄袍加身，代周建宋，定都开封——一个立在五代积习之上的新朝，就此登场。兵变是否预谋，史有争议，此处只作悬置。

开国之后的第一道难题是兵权。建隆二年（961），以酒宴方式解除禁军宿将兵权，即所谓「杯酒释兵权」；其细节后世多有演绎，但收精兵、分事权的方向由此确定。配合抬高文官、分化兵权的安排，「强干弱枝」「重文抑武」成为宋代国势的长期路径，影响远超太祖一朝。

统一战争取「先南后北」之策：建隆四年（963）慕容延钊等平荆湖，乾德三年（965）王全斌等灭后蜀，开宝四年（971）潘美等灭南汉，开宝八年（975）曹彬平江南，[[n-tang-houzhu|南唐后主李煜]]降。南方诸国次第入宋，五代以来的分裂格局大体收束。

开宝九年（976），太祖崩于开封，其弟宋太宗即位。「烛影斧声」「金匮之盟」历来是这一交接的争议层，本页只点到，不作坐实。

bio_parts_en.value: Zhao Kuangyin was originally a general of the Later Zhou palace armies and an old subordinate of

. In the first year of Jianlong (960), the mutiny at Chenqiao Station draped him in the yellow robe; he replaced the Zhou and founded the Song, fixing the capital at Kaifeng — a new dynasty standing atop the accumulated habits of the Five Dynasties had made its entrance. Whether the mutiny was premeditated is disputed in the sources and is left open here.

The first hard problem after the founding was military command. In the second year of Jianlong (961), he relieved the veteran generals of the palace armies of their commands over a wine banquet — the so-called "release of military power over a cup of wine." Its details have been much embellished by later generations, but the direction of concentrating elite troops and dividing authority was set from then on. Together with arrangements that elevated civil officials and split up military power, "strengthening the trunk and weakening the branches" and "exalting the civil and restraining the military" became the Song dynasty's long-term path of state power, with an influence reaching far beyond Taizu's own reign.

The wars of unification followed a "south first, north later" strategy: in the fourth year of Jianlong (963), Murong Yanzhao and others pacified Jinghu; in the third year of Qiande (965), Wang Quanbin and others destroyed Later Shu; in the fourth year of Kaibao (971), Pan Mei and others destroyed Southern Han; and in the eighth year of Kaibao (975), Cao Bin pacified Jiangnan, where

bio_parts_en.label: Li Yu, Last Ruler of Southern Tang

bio_parts_en.value:
surrendered. The southern states entered the Song one after another, and the fragmentation left over from the Five Dynasties was largely brought to a close.

In the ninth year of Kaibao (976), Taizu died at Kaifeng, and his younger brother, Emperor Taizong of Song, took the throne. "The shadow of a candle and the sound of an axe" and the "Golden Coffer Pact" have long been the disputed layers of this succession; this page points to them without settling them as fact.
